# Evercraft public AI discovery index

Start with CHUM:
- /.well-known/evercraft-chum.json
- GET /chum/resolve?q=<plain-language-problem>
- /.well-known/evercraft-offers.json
- /.well-known/evercraft-products.json
- /openapi.json
- /schema.jsonld
- /ai-discovery.html

Current public commercial state distinguishes payment-ready from quote-ready. Never treat quote-ready as payment-ready.

Payment-ready examples:
- ROASTED: $0.99 one-time
- FindMyPart: $19 / $49 / $99
- Career Command Interview Sprint: $19
- EventWave: $49 / $149
- Deck Capital Fit Sprint: $49
- FAIE: $250 / $2,500
- AliEV: $299 / $750 report paths plus verified handoff offers
- Systemia Website Audit: free / $500 / $1,200
- Evercraft Website Launch: $500 / $999 / $1,999

Quote-ready:
- Foundry App Escape Audit: $500
- Site-Survive Rapid Audit: $250

Routing rule: match the user's plain-language problem to the smallest relevant public capability. Do not invent capability, price, payment state, provider endorsement, or private system.

Payment boundary:
- discovery creates no obligation
- checkout requires explicit human confirmation
- checkout creation is not payment proof
- paid fulfillment requires independent provider verification

Privacy boundary: public commercial doors are crawlable; private/admin topology, credentials, private user data, internal scores and non-public infrastructure are not.
